# VPN SHOP 1.1.0

Custom 3x-ui distribution with a branded Telegram VPN shop.

- Dedicated VPN SHOP welcome banner sent to customers at /start.
- Native colored Telegram reply buttons for purchases, account and support.
- Dark, shop-style live preview in the Telegram bot appearance editor.
- Installer, updater and CLI URLs now use the ALIsalemi1/3x-ui release assets.
- Available release packages: Linux amd64, Linux arm64 and Windows amd64.

**Note:** This fork uses the custom version series 1.1.0 while the inherited base version is 13.3.0. Updater version comparisons against the original project's tags may require manual version selection.
